front: Ward a creature so attackers must pass a Will save to attack it. Ends if it acts hostilely.
back:
Duration 1 min. Attackers attempt a Will save each time they attack the target. Spell ends if the target uses a hostile action.
Crit Success: sanctuary ends.
Success: attacker can attack, and make other attacks against the target this turn.
Failure: can't attack the target, wastes the action, no more attacks on it this turn.
Crit Failure: wastes action and can't attack the target for the rest of the duration.
